name: dav-mcp
description: Let Claude read and organize the calendars, contacts and tasks on your own CalDAV/CardDAV server: Nextcloud, iCloud, Baikal, Radicale and more.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your CalDAV/CardDAV server, e.g. https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/ (Nextcloud) or https://caldav.icloud.com/

password.title: Password
password.description: Password or app-specific password for your DAV server. Stored in your system's secure credential store.

auth_method.title: Authentication method
auth_method.description: Basic works for almost every server and switches to Digest by itself when the server only offers Digest. Digest never sends the password.
